name: settings
notes: Each button moves a setting to its next value (cycle:NAME; step:NAME:+1 and step:NAME:-1 stop at the ends; set:NAME:VALUE). The game file (game.json) declares the game's own settings; language and volume are always there. Settings are kept for the player between runs. State: setting.NAME (its value), setting.NAME.text (the value as words: a language by its own name).
